  STAFF REPORT
  AGENDA ITEM NO. 1

TO: Tweedy Mile Advisory Board

FROM: Giselle Mares, Acting Management Analyst, City Manager’s Office

SUBJECT: Business Improvement District (BID) funding request for Fiscal Year 2022/23 Budget.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Review, discuss and consider approving the BID funding request received for
Christmas Street Decorations on Tweedy Mile.

BACKGROUND: The holiday season is around the corner and due to a supply shortage, the City is
cut for time in finding Christmas decorations for the Tweedy Mile Business District. The current
decorations owned by the City/Tweedy Mile Association are several years old and are showing
wear and tear. Research was done to find vendors to provide Christmas decor. The option to rent
was presented but the cost is about the same as purchasing. Purchasing the decorations would
allow us to reuse them for 5-10 years and the BID will be able to pay the installation, removal,
and storage annual cost- just below $10,000 each year.

The approved FY 22/23 BID Budget includes $20,000 for decoration of public place. Staff
recommendation is for the Tweedy Mile Advisory Board to approve the $20,000 to partially cover
the cost and request additional funding from the City Council for the remainder of the total
($59,923.00). A breakdown of the cost can be seen in Attachment 1- BID Funding Request Form.

Approved Fiscal Year 2022/23 Business Improvement District (BID) Budget
On May 10, 2022 the City Council approved the following BID budget for Fiscal Year 2022/23:

  a) $1,206 for the promotion of public events which are to take place on Tweedy Mile;
  b) $40,000 for the general promotion of retail trade activities; and
  c) $20,000 for decoration of any public place in the area.

As a result, the Board shall approve events and activities within the approved BID budget for each eligible
category listed above
